reply:
Thanks for correcting that. It changes things a lot. If you vacated in March 2022, more than 4 years have passed. A civil suit to recover money generally has to be filed within about 3 years, and the exact starting date is uncertain. Your claim may already be time-barred, unless something extended it, such as the landlord admitting the debt in writing more recently.

Please speak to a lawyer before spending money on this. Free legal aid: call 15100. Bring any messages where the landlord acknowledged owing you the deposit, especially recent ones.

You can still send the landlord a polite written request. Some landlords pay anyway.

open_questions: Any recent written acknowledgement of the debt?

refer_reason: More than 3 years since the deposit fell due; limitation may have expired.
